theme.referenceNotes: Direction: a quiet workbench for indie Android devs; calm, precise, deep harbour navy so the dark violet dashboard UI sits in its own world. Memorable element: the soft violet highlight that echoes the app's own accent buttons. Reference (SubTrack deck, made by this tool): vertical linear gradient of deep indigo-navy (#191C34 to #242845, measured), faint violet glow behind devices, white tight geometric grotesk at bold weight (mapped to Plus Jakarta Sans), one lavender highlight phrase on some headlines (#A597FF = brand light violet), sentence-case quiet eyebrows on a few slides, dark-framed phones bleeding off edges, glass callout cards on navy surface. Rhythm mirrored: centred hero, text-top, text-bottom, callouts, two phones, text-top, closer with badges. Note: 03-slide-editor.png actually shows the Plan and theme step with validation warnings, and 08-generate-log.png shows the export run log with a check per slide; copy written to what is visible.
